sloka: कृत्वा तत्र अभिषेकम् ते बभूवुः गत कल्मषाः ।धूत पापाः पुनः तेन तोयेन अथ शुभ अन्विता ॥१-४३-२७॥
transliteration: kṛtvā tatra abhiṣekam te babhūvuḥ gata kalmaṣāḥ ।dhūta pāpāḥ punaḥ tena toyena atha śubha anvitā ॥1-43-27॥

translations.english: Those cursed to fall from heaven to earth were absolved of their sins after bathing there (in the waters of Ganga).
